name: Monts-Valin National Park
policyReason: Sépaq allows dogs on two trails (Pic-de-la-Tête-de-Chien and Lac-des-Pères), summer and winter, and not in the campground or picnic area.
summary: Dogs are allowed on two trails, Pic-de-la-Tête-de-Chien and Lac-des-Pères, but not in campgrounds or picnic areas.

dogRules.text: Summer and winter trails: Pic-de-la-Tête-de-Chien and Lac-des-Pères.
No dogs in the campground or picnic area.
Dogs are generally admitted on summer trails from early May to late October.
